summary: Master the art of data manipulation with Python and unleash the power of visualization with Power BI. Join our training and excel in your data analysis journey.
lede: Data manipulation with Python and visualization with Power BI provides a practical workflow for inspecting, cleaning, reshaping, validating, and reporting on structured data. Using pandas, NumPy, Power Query, DAX, and dimensional modeling, you will connect reproducible data preparation with governed analytical models and interactive dashboards. Across this 10-day foundation-to-intermediate programme, you will work with CSV and Excel files, document transformation assumptions, build a star schema, create measures, and configure report filters for a defined business audience. Practical outputs include a data-quality report, cleaned dataset, transformation notebook, analytical data model, measure catalogue, and interactive dashboard.
audienceIntro: This Python and Power BI course is designed for professionals who prepare, analyze, model, or communicate business data and need a structured path from foundation skills to intermediate reporting practice.
prerequisites: You need a laptop capable of running a current Python distribution, Jupyter Notebook, and Power BI Desktop or an equivalent organizational Power BI environment. The course uses provided CSV and Excel datasets, so you do not need to bring confidential organizational data. No production deployment, advanced Python software engineering, or specialist statistics background is required.
